question: A sum invested at a certain rate of interest per annum, compounded annually, amounts to ₹3,600 in 2 years and to ₹6,480 in 4 years. What is the sum invested?
solution: **Concept Used:** A = P (1 + r/100)t **Calculation:** A = P (1 + r/100)t ⇒ 3600 = P (1 + r/100)2 ......(i)
